name: centrosomal protein 89

function.text: CEP89 is the approved symbol for centrosomal protein 89. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in chemical synaptic transmission; cilium assembly.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Adrenocortical carcinoma; Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: CEP89 encodes centrosomal protein 89. Its functions include chemical synaptic transmission and cilium assembly.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CEP89 have been reported in adrenocortical carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and chromophobe renal cell carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
